info.title: Firestone REST API
info.description: Static contract for the existing Firestone v0.1 REST adapter. The API is HTTP/1.1 over a private Unix-domain socket; it has no TCP listener and no bearer-token mode. Socket ownership and mode 0600 are the authentication boundary. The document lists the 19 methods explicitly authored in the Firestone router. Axum also performs its normal implicit HEAD handling for GET registrations, but those incidental HEAD variants are not separate Firestone operations. Unknown paths and unsupported methods both return the stable 404 ErrorEnvelope. JSON successes and errors use application/json without a charset; action progress defaults to application/x-ndjson; logs use text/plain. Closing a mutation stream stops delivery while the shared action continues to a safe point; closing a followed log stream cancels that open-ended read.

servers.description: Placeholder HTTP authority used by Unix-socket clients such as curl --unix-socket. No TCP connection is made.
servers.x-firestone-listener-override: --listen unix:PATH, restricted to a socket directly inside the resolved Firestone runtime directory

get.description: Returns the raw VersionResult payload. Request bodies and undocumented query fields are ignored; malformed percent encoding is rejected before routing.

200.description: Version, release identity, selected dependency pins, and resolved paths.

post.description: Layers the supplied MachineSpecPatch over the router's snapshot of global create defaults, validates the resulting effective spec, and dispatches the shared create action. Both name and spec are required; spec may be {}.

requestBody.description: Exactly one JSON object. Unknown fields are rejected.

get.description: Returns the effective spec, reconciled state, and nullable live supervision. Request bodies and undocumented query fields are ignored.

put.description: Accepts MachineSpec directly. Every property is input-optional because serde fills omitted properties from built-in MachineSpec defaults; this PUT therefore does not require clients to send every property.

200.description: Effective saved spec and all non-fatal warnings.

requestBody.description: A JSON object is required; {} resets the effective spec to built-in defaults. Unknown fields are rejected.

patch.description: Applies the sparse MachineSpecPatch through the shared layering and path-provenance rules. Null patch properties mean no update; use clear for deletion.

200.description: Effective saved spec and all non-fatal warnings.

requestBody.description: A JSON object is required; {} is a valid no-op. Unknown fields are rejected.

delete.description: The request body is ignored. If removal emits no progress before Result, success is an empty 204. If a running machine must stop first, success is a 200 NDJSON stream by default or a 200 aggregate when Accept selects application/json.

200.description: Removal progress and typed terminal result.

schema.description: LF-delimited compact JSON records. Progress records arrive as produced. Success ends with exactly one typed Result record; a dispatcher failure after progress ends with one ErrorEnvelope record under HTTP 200.

204.description: Machine removed without preceding progress. Empty body and no Content-Type header.

post.description: Streams shared action Events by default. Accept: application/json waits for completion and aggregates progress. Closing a mutation response stops delivery but the action continues to a safe point.

200.description: Start progress and terminal running result.

schema.description: LF-delimited compact JSON records. Progress records arrive as produced. Success ends with exactly one typed Result record; a dispatcher failure after progress ends with one ErrorEnvelope record under HTTP 200.

requestBody.description: Optional JSON object. A zero-byte body or {} uses wait=true and the configured start timeout; top-level JSON null is invalid.

post.description: Streams shared stop Events by default or aggregates when Accept selects application/json.

200.description: Stop progress and terminal stopped result.

schema.description: LF-delimited compact JSON records. Progress records arrive as produced. Success ends with exactly one typed Result record; a dispatcher failure after progress ends with one ErrorEnvelope record under HTTP 200.

requestBody.description: Optional JSON object. A zero-byte body or {} uses force=false and the configured stop timeout; top-level JSON null is invalid.

post.description: The HTTP request body must contain zero bytes; even {} is rejected. Restart uses the configured start timeout and the configured stop timeout, with no route-local timeout field.

200.description: Restart progress and terminal running result.

post.summary: Resize a machine's CPU and memory
post.description: Streams shared resize Events by default or aggregates when Accept selects application/json. A running machine is resized live only inside the max_vcpus and hotplug_size headroom of the VmConfig it booted with; a request beyond that headroom answers 409. A stopped machine is equivalent to a spec patch. The effective values are always persisted to the machine spec.

200.description: Resize progress and the terminal effective CPU and memory.

schema.description: LF-delimited compact JSON records. Progress records arrive as produced. Success ends with exactly one typed Result record; a dispatcher failure after progress ends with one ErrorEnvelope record under HTTP 200.

requestBody.description: Required JSON object naming the new cpus, memory, or both.

get.description: Returns sanitized text chunks from the selected owned log. Newlines are preserved; every other Unicode control character is replaced with U+FFFD. A Result before Output yields an empty 200. An error before Output is JSON; an error after streaming begins closes the text stream without an error record. Request bodies are ignored.

200.description: Sanitized log bytes, streamed without an added delimiter.

get.description: Returns the canonical persisted Cloud Hypervisor v53 JSON value (maximum 51,200 bytes). Validated config_overlay data may add fields, so the schema deliberately remains extensible. Request bodies and undocumented query fields are ignored.
Returns the merged built-in and user catalog in canonical-reference order, independent of the local image cache. Request bodies and undocumented query fields are ignored.
Returns every valid stored image pair. Request bodies and undocumented query fields are ignored.

post.description: Streams image resolution, download, verification, and conversion Events by default. Accept: application/json aggregates them. sha256 may be supplied only for a direct HTTPS reference.

200.description: Image pull progress and terminal stored-image result.

schema.description: LF-delimited compact JSON records. Progress records arrive as produced. Success ends with exactly one typed Result record; a dispatcher failure after progress ends with one ErrorEnvelope record under HTTP 200.

requestBody.description: Exactly one JSON object. ref is required; sha256 may be omitted or null. Unknown fields are rejected.

post.description: The HTTP request body must contain zero bytes; even {} is rejected. Progress Events are collected internally and discarded; success returns only the typed prune payload.

200.description: Removed image IDs and total bytes freed.

delete.description: The request body and Accept header are ignored. Progress and the internal ImageRemoveResult are discarded; success is always empty 204.

204.description: Image removed. Empty body and no Content-Type header.

Architecture.description: CPU architecture accepted by the shared machine model.

oneOf.description: Whole MiB with no suffix or M/m, from 0 through 17592186044415; surrounding whitespace and leading zeroes are accepted.
Whole GiB with G/g, from 0 through 17179869183; surrounding whitespace and leading zeroes are accepted.

ByteSize.description: Canonical whole-MiB or whole-GiB size emitted by Firestone.

ImageRef.description: Catalog reference, strict HTTPS URL, or local image path. Pull resolution performs source-specific validation.

Firmware.description: auto, rhf, edk2, or a non-empty UTF-8 firmware path.

PortForward.description: [proto:][bind:]HOST:GUEST. Protocol is tcp (default) or udp; port/range endpoints are 1 through 65535 and host/guest ranges have equal lengths.

JsonObject.description: JSON object; nested null values retain RFC 7396 deletion semantics.

MountSpecInput.description: One virtio-fs mount. host and guest are required; readonly defaults to false and tag defaults to a generated shareN value when omitted.

NetworkSpecInput.description: All properties may be omitted and inherit NetworkSpec defaults. Only the Option-backed tap and mac properties accept JSON null.

CloudInitSpecInput.description: All properties may be omitted and inherit CloudInitSpec defaults. Only user_data and network_config accept JSON null.

VmmSpecInput.description: All properties may be omitted and inherit VmmSpec defaults. binary and config_overlay accept JSON null; config_overlay must otherwise be an object.

cpus_max.description: Optional vCPU hotplug ceiling; must be at least cpus.

memory_max.description: Optional memory hotplug ceiling; must be at least memory.

MachineSpecInput.description: Complete-spec input accepted by PUT. Because MachineSpec uses serde defaults, every property may be omitted and is filled from built-in defaults. Only arch, cpus_max and memory_max are Option-backed and accept JSON null. Unknown properties are rejected.

cpus_max.description: Opt-in vCPU hotplug ceiling. Null means no headroom: max_vcpus equals cpus and a running machine cannot gain vCPUs.

memory_max.description: Opt-in memory hotplug ceiling. Null means no headroom: the VmConfig carries no hotplug_size and a running machine cannot gain memory.

MachineSpec.description: Effective machine spec returned by Firestone. Optional values are emitted as JSON null; all top-level properties are present.

tap.description: Empty text is accepted while inactive; the effective value is validated as a Linux TAP name when mode is tap.

NetworkSpecPatch.description: Sparse network layer. Missing or null properties make no change; use the root clear list to remove an effective value.

CloudInitSpecPatch.description: Sparse cloud-init layer. Missing or null properties make no change.

VmmSpecPatch.description: Sparse VMM layer. config_overlay must be an object when non-null.

cpus_max.description: Optional vCPU hotplug ceiling; must be at least cpus.

memory_max.description: Optional memory hotplug ceiling; must be at least memory.

MachineSpecPatch.description: Sparse layer used by create and PATCH. Every property is optional. Null Option-backed values are treated as absent, not as clear operations. clear is the only way to clear optional or vector leaves; a layer cannot set and clear the same leaf.

name.description: One non-empty Unix path component without control characters.

wait.description: Wait for guest SSH readiness when true.

timeout_s.description: Whole-second start/readiness deadline. Omission or null uses the configured start timeout.

StartRequest.description: Optional JSON body. An empty HTTP body is equivalent to {}.

timeout_s.description: Whole-second stop deadline. Omission or null uses the configured stop timeout.

force.description: Allow forced teardown after the graceful stop path.

StopRequest.description: Optional JSON body. An empty HTTP body is equivalent to {}.

sha256.description: Optional complete source SHA-256. The dispatcher normalizes accepted hexadecimal to lowercase.

anyOf.description: Pinned image identifier as stored in state; state serde does not enforce the image-store ID grammar.
Pinned source digest as stored in state; state serde does not enforce digest syntax.

reason.description: Known values include guest shutdown, stale, and host reboot; concrete failure diagnostics are also preserved.

LastExit.description: code and signal cannot both be non-null.

anyOf.description: Persisted state text; state serde does not re-parse it as MacAddr.

cid.description: Production-created machines use 3; state serde accepts any u32 and VmConfig generation rejects non-3 values.

DoctorCheck.description: fix and hint are omitted when absent; they are never emitted as null.

sshd_path.description: Omitted when the default /usr/sbin/sshd applies; dot and dot-dot components are forbidden.

ImageMetadata.description: Strict image sidecar metadata. sshd_path is omitted when it has the default value.

ErrorInfo.description: hint is omitted when the error has no public remediation hint.

VmCpusConfig.description: Firestone emits boot_vcpus from cpus and max_vcpus from cpus_max, defaulting to cpus.

hotplug_size.description: Present only when memory_max is set; equals memory_max minus memory.

VmPayloadConfig.description: Exactly one Firestone-owned boot payload is present. A validated config overlay may add non-conflicting Cloud Hypervisor fields.

VmMachineDisk.description: First disk: writable qcow2 overlay. readonly is absent or false.

VmSeedDisk.description: Second disk: read-only raw CIDATA seed. backing_files is absent or false.

VmAdditionalDisk.description: Additional Cloud Hypervisor disk supplied by a validated config overlay.

VmNetConfig.description: Tap fields or passt vhost-user fields are present according to the resolved network plan; absent optional fields are omitted.

net.description: The Firestone-owned first entry is typed; validated config_overlay may append Cloud Hypervisor entries.

fs.description: Contains the Firestone-owned filesystem entries; validated config_overlay may append Cloud Hypervisor entries.

VmConfig.description: Canonical Cloud Hypervisor v53 VmConfig persisted for the machine. net and fs are omitted when disabled. A validated RFC 7396 config overlay may add fields but cannot change Firestone-owned required values.

oneOf.description: Whole MiB from 128 through 17592186044415; surrounding whitespace and leading zeroes are accepted.
Whole GiB from 1 through 17179869183; surrounding whitespace and leading zeroes are accepted.

MemorySizeInput.description: Machine memory must resolve to at least 128 MiB and fit in u64 bytes.

MemorySize.description: Canonical effective memory size, at least 128 MiB.

GuestMountPath.description: Canonical absolute non-root guest path with no dot components, duplicate separators, trailing slash, NUL, or ASCII control characters. Linux byte and component limits are validated after decoding.

MachineImageRef.description: Machine image reference containing at least one non-whitespace character.

cpus.description: New vCPU count. Omission or null leaves cpus unchanged.

memory.description: New guest memory. Omission or null leaves memory unchanged.

ResizeRequest.description: At least one of cpus and memory must resolve to a value; a body that changes nothing is a usage error.

applied_live.description: True when Cloud Hypervisor accepted vm.resize for the running machine. False means the values were written to the spec and apply on the next start.

MachineName.name: name
MachineName.description: Percent-decoded UTF-8 machine name. Core path validation requires one non-empty Unix path component without control characters.

ImageId.name: id
ImageId.description: Complete lowercase stable image ID shown by GET /v1/images.

Force.name: force
Force.description: Defaults to false. Unknown, duplicate, or non-boolean query fields are rejected on force-query routes.

LogSource.name: source
LogSource.description: Owned log source. virtiofsd-N accepts a decimal u16 index from 0 through 65535. Defaults to console.

LogFollow.name: follow
LogFollow.description: Keep the text stream open and follow safe rotations. Defaults to false.

LogLines.name: lines
LogLines.description: Number of trailing lines. Zero is valid.

ActionError400.description: Bad request: usage or invalid_spec. Before the first event, a default-stream dispatcher error is one NDJSON line; request-validation errors remain JSON. With JSON aggregation selected, dispatcher errors are JSON.

Error404.description: Resource or route not found: not_found.

ActionError404.description: Resource or route not found: not_found. Before the first event, a default-stream dispatcher error is one NDJSON line; request-validation errors remain JSON. With JSON aggregation selected, dispatcher errors are JSON.

ActionError409.description: Conflict: conflict, already_running, or busy. Before the first event, a default-stream dispatcher error is one NDJSON line; request-validation errors remain JSON. With JSON aggregation selected, dispatcher errors are JSON.

Error500.description: Internal action failure: generic, not_running, already_exists, or interrupted.

ActionError500.description: Internal action failure: generic, not_running, already_exists, or interrupted. Before the first event, a default-stream dispatcher error is one NDJSON line; request-validation errors remain JSON. With JSON aggregation selected, dispatcher errors are JSON.

Error502.description: Image checksum or verification failure: checksum.

ActionError502.description: Image checksum or verification failure: checksum. Before the first event, a default-stream dispatcher error is one NDJSON line; request-validation errors remain JSON. With JSON aggregation selected, dispatcher errors are JSON.

Error503.description: Host dependency unavailable or broken: dependency.

ActionError503.description: Host dependency unavailable or broken: dependency. Before the first event, a default-stream dispatcher error is one NDJSON line; request-validation errors remain JSON. With JSON aggregation selected, dispatcher errors are JSON.

ActionError504.description: Bounded action deadline exceeded: timeout. Before the first event, a default-stream dispatcher error is one NDJSON line; request-validation errors remain JSON. With JSON aggregation selected, dispatcher errors are JSON.
